page_title: ACM 3-2 PAR | AC Milan v Parma 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Rosario Abisso saw the whole situation.
90+5' 3 - 2 Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) gets on the end of a perfect cross after one of the defenders fails to clear and strikes the ball inside the left post!
90+2' 2 - 2 Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
90+1' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for AC Milan due to an offside in the build-up play.
89' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The AC Milan players aren’t happy.

88' A perfect lofted pass from Samuel Chukwueze finds Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Zion Suzuki had no chance of stopping that. 2:2.
86' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.
83' Here is a change. Matteo Cancellieri is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
80' 1 - 2 Goal! 1:2. The ball rebounds to Enrico Del Prato (Parma) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
80' Mathias Lovik (Parma) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
77' Today's match ends for Davide Calabria who will be replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
77' Fabio Pecchia has decided to make a change. Mathias Lovik (Parma) replaces Valentin Mihaila.
75' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.

74' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
74' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.

73' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Pontus Almqvist (Parma) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan pulls off a comfortable save.
71' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
70' That will be all from Milan Djuric who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Drissa Camara (Parma).
70' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Hernani and he is replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).
69' Dennis Man goes off the pitch and Pontus Almqvist (Parma) comes on.
68' Hernani (Parma) is able to continue to play.
65' Hernani (Parma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
63' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes.

60' A sweet pass finds Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Zion Suzuki is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
58' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
57' Sergio Conceicao decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Morata will be replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
57' Substitution. Youssouf Fofana leaves the pitch and is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
55' Parma take a short corner kick.
54' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in a cross from the corner, but Zion Suzuki reads it well and gathers the ball.
53' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the left post.
51' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) picks up an injury.
46' The game is interrupted as Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is flagged offside.
46' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Davide Bartesaghi comes on the pitch for Theo Hernandez (AC Milan).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Sergio Conceicao gives a chance to Ismael Bennacer and Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Enrico Del Prato (Parma) was quite harsh and Rosario Abisso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
45+1' Dennis Man (Parma) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Mike Maignan makes a great save to stop his effort.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
43' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
42' None of the Parma players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
40' Poor challenge! Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is penalised for tripping and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Zion Suzuki.
38' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
37' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
37' Simon Sohm (Parma) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
36' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to AC Milan using VAR. Let's see what happens.
36' Zion Suzuki (Parma) makes a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty for AC Milan!
35' A dangerous looking corner kick from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is cleared to safety by the defence.
34' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
33' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
31' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
29' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
26' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
24' 0 - 1 Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
23' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
22' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
21' PENALTY APPEAL after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
19' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends it out of play.
18' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
14' Rosario Abisso blows for a foul after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
12' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Rosario Abisso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
11' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
11' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. Now AC Milan have a corner.
11' The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it. Davide Calabria (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
8' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes a short corner kick.
8' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
5' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sprays a pass out to Theo Hernandez, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
2' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
2' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Rosario Abisso.
